findings.detail: Zarya Intermediate was flagged with cost -84000, but the SOI row has cost as dash and fair value as (84).
Pluralsight was flagged with a negative cost matching a parenthetical fair value while the SOI cost cell is dash.

rationale: Class 1 cell check. Several negative costs are source-confirmed parenthetical cost cells, for example table 34 rows 7 and 9, so the rule is not categorically a defect. However, at least one flagged negative cost is not present in the source cost column: table 44 row 37 shows Zarya Intermediate with cost dash and fair value (84), matching the observed -84000 in the extracted cost field. That is a localized extraction/column mapping error, so the aggregate C107 item is a real error.
